context_diary: Understanding the structure and function behaviors of the system helps in efficiently retrieving the required data without unnecessary overload. When retrieving information from the system, it is important to execute the right commands in sequence. First, I used the account_lookup function to retrieve random agents and found there were 1498 agent records. I retrieved a sample of three agents to prevent overloading the system. Next, I accessed the total user count using the aggregation_reporting function and found there were 8497 users. Finally, I used the account_lookup function again to fetch the admin's email. I looked up currency type agents using the account_lookup function and found four agents handling different currencies. I also retrieved their email addresses using the same function to complete the information.
